summary: postinstall beacon exfiltrates installer host and path info to hardcoded Discord webhook
details: package.json declares a postinstall script (`node index.js`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. The script resolves an absolute filesystem path via `__filename` (which reveals the installer's username and home directory layout), collects Node.js version, platform, and architecture, and POSTs this data to a hardcoded Discord webhook at discord.com/api/webhooks/1530599209269465319/... The webhook URL is split across two concatenated string literals to obscure it. Internal default packageName `whs4_typo` and the absence of any legitimate library functionality indicate a dependency-confusion / typosquat reconnaissance beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
